description: This file contains functions and helpers related to handling images within the Excalidraw project, including loading images, updating image caches, normalizing SVGs, and filtering image elements.

methods.name: loadHTMLImageElement
methods.description: Loads an HTMLImageElement from a DataURL, returning a promise that resolves when the image is loaded.

methods.name: updateImageCache
methods.description: Updates the image cache with new images from given file IDs, handling errors and caching promises.

methods.name: getInitializedImageElements
methods.description: Filters and returns image elements that are initialized from a list of Excalidraw elements.

methods.name: isHTMLSVGElement
methods.description: Type guard to check if a DOM node is an SVGElement.

methods.name: normalizeSVG
methods.description: Normalizes an SVG string by ensuring proper attributes and viewBox, and returns the outer HTML of the SVG.
